objects.name: Analytic 2185
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) network device telemetry gaps -- Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) polling returning inconsistent results, syslog sequence gaps -- suggesting kernel-level manipulation of device-reported state. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
